integrity: Standalone executable verifies finite examples, not the infinite proof. All authorship and priority outside the cited evidence are unasserted.
scientific_limitations: Requires primes p congruent 5 modulo 8 for which 2 has multiplicative order p-1; no infinitude, optimal-code classification, or solution for p+1 claimed. The theorem uses the published universal lower bound and Hamming identity.
title: Two new sharp prime-root lengths for completely unclustered Burrows–Wheeler images
